himki.description: HIMKI is Indonesia’s national furniture and handicraft industry association, connecting manufacturers and artisans with global buyers, policy support, and export-market opportunities.

blotani.description: BLOTANI is listed as a Trade Expo Indonesia 2026 exhibitor in the furniture and home décor sector at Hall 9, Booth 9-1A. Public contact links are shown only when they can be matched to a reliable official or industry source.

nuansa-kayu-bekas-cv.description: CV Nuansa Kayu Bekas develops furniture and home décor from reclaimed or waste wood, with export-oriented products and a sustainability-led material story.

kalika-indonesia.description: Kalika Indonesia offers Indonesian furniture and home-living products for international buyers through Infinity Global Export.

sinar-continental-pt.description: PT Sinar Continental supplies upholstery and interior fabrics for furniture, home-living, and commercial interior applications.

homeliving-by-exoticawood-furniture.description: Exoticawood Furniture develops Indonesian furniture and home-living products with an export-oriented focus on wood craftsmanship and custom collections.

home-fashions-indonesia-cv-sae-home.description: SAE Home Living is a Yogyakarta-based furniture brand with export experience, producing locally sourced wood furniture and custom collections with sustainability-focused production.
